meta.name: analytical-method-validation
meta.description: Plan, execute, and document validation, verification, and transfer of analytical procedures under the governing framework - ICH Q2(R2) and Q14, USP <1220>/<1225>/<1226>, ICH M10 bioanalytical, CLSI EP, or ISO/IEC 17025. Use for HPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC, CE, ICP-MS, dissolution, qNMR, qPCR, NIR, and ligand binding or cell-based assays whenever the question is whether a procedure is fit for its intended purpose. Triggers include "method validation", "analytical method validation", "AMV", "validation protocol", "acceptance criteria", "linearity", "reportable range", "accuracy and precision", "repeatability", "intermediate precision", "recovery", "LOD", "LOQ", "detection limit", "quantitation limit", "specificity", "robustness", "method transfer", "method comparison", "Deming", "Passing-Bablok", "Bland-Altman", "equivalence testing", "OOS investigation", "ICH Q2", "Q2(R2)", "Q14", "USP 1225", "ICH M10", "incurred sample reanalysis", "ISR", "CLSI EP", and any request to show that an assay works.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证分析方法是否符合法规要求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在制药或生物分析实验室中验证分析方法的合规性。
copy.tagline_en: Validate analytical methods for regulatory compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to validate analytical methods in pharma or bioanalysis labs.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude能帮你规划并记录分析方法的验证、确认与转移：选定适用的法规框架（如ICH Q2(R2)、ICH M10），生成验证方案，并用内置脚本计算线性、准确度、精密度、检测限/定量限，判定生物分析运行是否合格、比较两种方法是否等效。产出方案与统计报告。
howto.when: 当你提到“方法验证”“线性”“LOD/LOQ”等关键词，或要求确认某个分析程序是否适合预期用途、做方法转移/比较时触发。

say.text: 帮我按ICH Q2(R2)规划一个HPLC含量测定的验证方案。
say.note: 会生成验证协议模板，并提示需提前设定接受标准。

say.text: 用check_accuracy_precision.py分析我的精密度数据。
say.note: 脚本会按单向随机效应模型分水平计算重复性和中间精密度。

say.text: 比较这两台仪器测得的配对数据是否等效。
say.note: 用TOST检验并给出等效结论。

howto.what_en: Claude plans, executes, and documents analytical method validation/verification/transfer: selects framework (ICH Q2(R2), ICH M10, etc.), generates protocols, and runs scripts for linearity, accuracy/precision, limits, bioanalytical run checks, and method comparison. Outputs protocols and statistics.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like 'method validation', 'linearity', 'LOD/LOQ', or ask whether a procedure is fit for its intended purpose, method transfer, or comparison.

say_en.text: Plan an ICH Q2(R2) validation protocol for an HPLC assay.
say_en.note: Generates a protocol skeleton and asks for acceptance criteria.

say_en.text: Run check_accuracy_precision.py on my precision data.
say_en.note: Computes repeatability and intermediate precision per level.

say_en.text: Compare paired data from two instruments for equivalence.
say_en.note: Uses TOST and reports equivalence verdict.
